note: Every comment under cloudflare-worker/src that mentions Cloudflare Access, quoted in part and vouched for. Task #33 took the Access middleware off /api/admin/*, /api/monitoring/* and /api/infra/* (index.ts records why); seventeen comments in twelve files went on describing the removed perimeter as live, so a reader believed the admin API had an identity layer in front of it that it does not have. What is still true is listed here. An entry is a file, a phrase copied from the comment (whitespace is collapsed, so wrapping does not matter), and one line saying why the sentence is true. A mention no entry quotes fails; an entry whose phrase is no longer in any comment of its file fails, so this list cannot outlive the sentences it vouches for. Never a line number: a line number goes stale with the next edit above it.
resolve_with: Correct the comment to say what is true — the gate is requireAdmin or requireSuperAdmin in the handler, and Access guards only the two KYC document routes in index.ts. Add an entry here only for a sentence that is true, with the reason it is.
